resources.string: Save new documents automatically to a folder you choose once you start typing. Received text stays in memory until you choose Save.
BeauTyXT keeps access to your chosen folder until you turn this off. Turning it off does not delete files already created. Your storage provider may sync files in that folder.
New documents stay in memory until you save them.
Saved autosave settings couldn\'t be loaded. Try again or reset them to turn new-document autosave off.
This turns off new-document autosave and clears saved folder access. Existing files in your folder are not deleted.
Choose a local folder where BeauTyXT can create and save files.
The chosen folder isn\'t available right now. Try again or choose another folder.
Access to your autosave folder was removed or the folder is gone. Choose a folder again or turn autosave off.
Your previous folder change didn\'t finish. Choose a folder again or turn autosave off.
No folder picker is available on this device.
Close the open document using this folder before changing or turning off autosave.
Your autosave folder isn\'t accessible anymore. Save this document manually, or choose a folder again from Home.
This folder\'s storage provider doesn\'t support verified autosave. Choose Save as new file to save elsewhere.
Couldn\'t create a file in your autosave folder. Your text is still here.
The folder didn\'t confirm file creation, so BeauTyXT stopped retrying to avoid duplicates. Check your folder or choose Save as new file.
New document wasn\'t saved to a file
